QUOTE: "The `code` notice says reads are live and only writes are affected, after an earlier message gave a false all-clear (gh#348)." and "Until then, `build_or_refresh` refuses (server.py:2278, `stale_code_refusal`), `force` cannot override the refusal, and `_data_stale` checks `matches_source` first so auto-refresh never attempts a build that could drop layers."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that on the code axis reads are live while only writes/builds are affected, and that builds are refused to avoid dropping layers. That covers the read/write asymmetry. It never says outright that queries open the database per call.
